questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm straight out to the side, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that an action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make U-turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane for left turns only. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing with a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride near traffic. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely to be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When you see a green light and want to turn left, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has multiple curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you to be alert for bicycles in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a side road is coming up. Watch for vehicles entering from that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with a yellow background and black symbols. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with the palm facing up and then swings it upward, this hand signal tells other riders to increase their speed. Hand signals are used to communicate when riding in groups.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, the symbol shows a right turn is prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that an upcoming bridge is narrow and you may not be able to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully and be prepared to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand pointing upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs alert drivers to work zones ahead. This sign warns that the highway is under repair or maintenance. Slow down and drive carefully through the construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple turns or curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows one way only. You cannot enter from your current direction.
